# Independently stated MTS vectors. Updated Specification, pages 2, 4-8.
# Z12 = twelve 40 bytes; Z24 = twelve 40 00 pairs.
# NAME = sixteen 20 bytes; TABLE = 128 no-change triplets.
BulkDumpRequest|f0 7e 01 08 00 02 f7
BankedDumpRequest|f0 7e 01 08 03 03 02 f7
BulkDump|f0 7e 01 08 01 02 NAME TABLE 74 f7
KeyBasedDump|f0 7e 01 08 04 03 02 NAME TABLE 72 f7
ScaleOctaveDump7|f0 7e 01 08 05 03 02 NAME Z12 73 f7
ScaleOctaveDump14|f0 7e 01 08 06 03 02 NAME Z24 70 f7
SingleNoteChange|f0 7f 01 08 02 02 01 45 45 00 00 f7
BankedNoteChangeTrue|f0 7f 01 08 07 03 02 01 45 45 00 00 f7
BankedNoteChangeFalse|f0 7e 01 08 07 03 02 01 45 45 00 00 f7
ScaleOctaveChange7True|f0 7f 01 08 08 02 01 01 Z12 f7
ScaleOctaveChange7False|f0 7e 01 08 08 02 01 01 Z12 f7
ScaleOctaveChange14True|f0 7f 01 08 09 02 01 01 Z24 f7
ScaleOctaveChange14False|f0 7e 01 08 09 02 01 01 Z24 f7
